items.prompt: 原题 Editing·第1段：The United States: Melting Pot or Salad Bowl?
items.instruction: 找出本段有问题的句子，写出原句号与错误类型；然后重写完整段落，纠正平行结构及其他句子问题。注意：并非每句都有错。
items.answer:
定位：第1句 stringy；第2、7句 comma splice；第5、6句 choppy，可合并。
参考改写：The United States counts its population every ten years, and each census reveals that the racial and ethnic mix is changing dramatically. Therefore, by the year 2050, the “average” person in the United States will not be descended from Europeans; instead, the majority of U.S. residents will trace their ancestry to Africa, Asia, the Hispanic world, the Pacific Islands, or the Middle East. Once the United States was a microcosm of European nationalities; however, today the United States is a microcosm of the world. The United States is no longer considered a “melting pot” society by many of its residents. Instead, many people prefer the term “salad bowl.” They use this term to describe U.S. society, which will soon be predominantly nonwhite. “Melting pot” implies that the different ethnic groups blend together into one homogeneous mixture; on the other hand, “salad bowl” implies that nationalities, like the ingredients in a mixed green salad, retain their cultural identities.
items.explanation: 第1句连续 and/so/but 太长，先把人口变化与预测分组；第2、7句是两个独立句只靠逗号连接；第6句补充 society 的特点，可用 which 接到第5句。第3、4句无需强行改错。
items.passage: (1) The United States counts its population every 10 years, and each census reveals that the racial and ethnic mix is changing dramatically, so by the year 2050, the “average” person in the United States will not be descended from Europeans, but the majority of U.S. residents will trace their ancestry to Africa, Asia, the Hispanic world, the Pacific Islands, or the Middle East. (2) Once the United States was a microcosm of European nationalities, today the United States is a microcosm of the world. (3) The United States is no longer considered a “melting pot” society by many of its residents. (4) Instead, many people prefer the term “salad bowl.” (5) They use this term to describe U.S. society. (6) U.S. society will soon be predominantly nonwhite. (7) “Melting pot” implies that the different ethnic groups blend together into one homogeneous mixture, “salad bowl” implies that nationalities, like the ingredients in a mixed green salad, retain their cultural identities.
rubric: 标出第1、2、5–6、7句的问题及类型。
实际重写整段，既修连接错误，也改善碎句和长串句。
保留第1–7句全部主要信息，不只列错误清单。

参考改写：Earlier generations of immigrants believed that they had to learn English quickly not only to survive but also to succeed. Now, many immigrant groups do not feel the same need because there are many places in the United States where you can work, shop, get medical care, marry, divorce, and die without knowing English such as Chinatown in San Francisco and New York and Vietnamese and Mexican neighborhoods in Los Angeles. In addition, many immigrant groups want their children to know their own culture. Many Hispanics, for instance, want their children to learn both English and Spanish in school, so they are fighting for the right to bilingual education in communities where they are in the majority.
items.explanation: not only 后是 to survive，but also 后也应是 to succeed；第14句 both/and 后应同为 English 和 Spanish 两个名词。Because 从句接第9句，For example 名词片段接到相关主句；第16句用 where 补充 communities。答案册整段只是一个可行示例，也可用更短的合法句子。

(11) For example, Chinatown in San Francisco and New York. (12) Also, Los Angeles has many Vietnamese immigrants and immigrants from Mexico. (13) In addition, many immigrant groups want their children to know their own culture. (14) Many Hispanics, for instance, want their children to learn both English and study the Spanish language in school. (15) They are fighting for the right to bilingual education in many communities. (16) In many communities they are in the majority.
